answers.core: This isn't something that can really be solved by a script or plugin as far as I'm aware. It's something best to be added to the engine.
answers.workaround: There are some ways to work around this, but they aren't pretty. One way is by placing a semi-transparent object above it, the other solution is creating 30 tiles where each tile is a different tile for every tile in my game. This is not efficient, but it's an alternative.

title: Ability to modulate a single tile within a tilemap
